purpose: Score an expanded eligible set built without a per-fill floor, and record the owners of the five Maduro Safes. Parent H1 through H7 stay as published. They are not replaced.

dedup.unit: One OrderFilled log, identified by transaction hash and log index.
dedup.sides: Maker and taker are the two sides of that one log. A wallet is credited on the side where its address appears. If maker and taker are the same address, the log is counted once for that wallet.
dedup.exchange: An exchange or operator contract is not a wallet. A side whose address is one of the CTF, NegRisk, or V3 exchange contracts is dropped. orders_matched is not added on top of OrderFilled.
dedup.test: A published transaction hash is read from Polygon and from the archive. The log indexes must match, and the exchange address must not appear as a wallet.

expanded_eligible.rule: Chronological high-water of buy notional minus sell notional on one outcome of one condition, with no per-fill floor. Eligible at 1000 USD. YES and NO are never summed. Recycling uses the same high-water rule as the parent.
expanded_eligible.sub_100_only: A wallet-outcome is sub-100-only when every buy on that outcome is under 100 USD and the high-water still reaches 1000 USD.
expanded_eligible.near_band: The 44752 wallet-outcomes whose 100 USD-floor gross buy was at least 900 and under 1000 are re-scored with the small fills included. They are newly eligible only if the high-water then reaches 1000.
expanded_eligible.partials: The 161 information markets still partial at 15 pages are re-read from an archive when the archive covers their dates, otherwise by further public API pages.

H1e_H2e_H3e.statement: The parent H1, H2 and H3 statistics are computed again on the expanded eligible set. The control remains PUBLIC_PROCESS markets inside the same volume quintiles. The three tests share a Bonferroni threshold of 0.05/3.
H1e_H2e_H3e.if_the_archive_cannot_support_the_rate: The re-run is reported as not executed, with the reason. The parent verdicts are not copied forward as if they were the new test.
H1e_H2e_H3e.not_a_rewrite: Parent p-values stay in the parent tables.

H7_remains_a_case: H7 is not turned into a rate. It stays NOT_OBSERVED unless a second wallet on the same Maduro NO outcome received at least 1000 USD from the named EOA or from a non-contract that paid that EOA before block 81097973.

safes.method: eth_call getOwners and getThreshold. AddedOwner and SafeSetup logs where the public RPC returns them. An owner is a signer. A public name is recorded only with a source. The master copy is not an owner.
safes.pnl: Collateral identity from investigations/data-completion-20261123/scripts/ledger_build.py, applied only where the fills for that Safe can be read.

not_a_service_by_nonce_alone: Nonce and recipient count are recorded. An address is infrastructure only with contract code, the existing infrastructure list, or a documented exchange, bridge, relayer or mixer role.
